title: Running the two-move machine
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb{N}$, let $i$ be one of $m$ work tapes, and choose a head movement $\delta\in\{-1,0,1\}$. For any input string $x$ and configuration $d$ whose state is $0$, after every $u\in\mathbb{N}$ with $u\le 2$, the machine that in states $0$ and $1$ moves tape $i$ by $\delta$ and advances to the next state, and otherwise makes no change to the tapes and stays in its state, reaches the configuration obtained from $d$ by setting the state to $u$ and the head position of tape $i$ to its original position plus $u\delta$; all other configuration components are unchanged.
